reviews.review_description: From start to finish Pure electric provided best in class service.As someone that had 0 knowledge of solar and battery technology and blasé with our own power consumption, we have been shown the way of the future with Pure electrics experience.Everything ran smoothly and also ahead of quoted time. Flexible with solar array location and giving best system advice for full home backup.Experienced first grid outage recently and did not even notice a flicker or have internet drop out.

Tom provided a very detailed quote and came out to our site to check everything out before installation. Answered all of our questions arranged for old solar hot water panels and evaporative cooler to be removed.Installation. went smoothly. Tradesmen arrived on time. Explained all work. Set up and Showed me how to use the Tesla app for the battery.Organized grid connection and all paperwork. Checked the system is working from their end and even recommended a retailer with the highest feed in tariff. Worksite left clean and tidy.

I had an exceptional experience with Pure Electric Solutions from start to finish. The sales and quoting process was clear, honest, and incredibly informative — Tom patiently walked me through everything, even though I was completely new to solar. What truly stood out was their empathy and professionalism when I was involved in a serious accident and had to postpone the installation. They handled it with such understanding and flexibility, without any pressure. When the time came, the installers were punctual, polite, and left everything spotless. The system was explained thoroughly, and they even helped organise the grid connection and made sure I felt confident using both the solar panels and the battery. I can’t recommend them highly enough — I even recommended them to my brother who is now also getting a system installed from them!Pure Electrics is reliable, compassionate, and truly customer-focused.Sales/Quoting Process:Excellent — clear, upfront, and no pushy sales tactics. I had a lot of questions, and Tom patiently answered every one, making sure I understood how the solar and battery system would work, including options for future upgrades.Installation:Delayed due to a major accident I had — the company was incredibly understanding and rescheduled with zero hassle. When the install happened, the team was punctual, polite, and left the site spotless. They worked efficiently and respectfully.Customer Service:Outstanding. They not only managed all the paperwork and grid connection setup but also made sure I knew how to monitor and use the system. Their follow-up and support were top-notch.Overall:A genuinely compassionate and professional company. If you’re looking for a team that combines technical know-how with excellent people skills, look no further.
Too early to say, very helpful so far.

The installation of our solar system including a battery and heat pump was a positive experience.It started with using the Solar Quotes platform to identify suitable companies to approach for quotes. All companies were responsive, professional and good to work with. We did however decide on another company, Pure Electrics, that wasn’t one of those initial companies but is on the Solar Quotes list. The Pure Electrics team were great to work with and offered a more holistic approach from the heat pump, solar system, battery and through to planning for an EV. This was all done in late 2023 with the amazing Callunn and his son completing the installation 2 days before Christmas. Callunn’s attention to detail and quality of his work was very impressive.It’s early days but all going very well!

Cracking team at Pure Electric. Engineering mindset (not pushy salespeople), holistic view of solar in the full electrification journey, collaborative approach to finding a system that fits the roof and the budget - with multiple tweaks  to refine to our exact requirements. They've got industry and engineering knowledge, and know how to apply it to produce efficient designs. The install itself was flawless and we're now enjoying the insights from the Fronius smart meter. Also nice touch with the registering of extended warranty on our behalf :-)

Sale and quoting process was quick and very clear to understand what we were getting, what it would cost and how much of a rebate we were intitled to. The system Paul designed was beyond our expectations and a fantastic result for us. Assistance with the government grants and the follow up for this process was great, we would have found it confusing and a little dauting. Applications and process was all taken care of by our installer.Delivery & installation was organised quickly and carried out by professional, polite & knowledgeable individuals. Our install site wasn't so straight forward but installers persevered to get the job done. Very happy with the result.Our lack of understanding how inverters need to communicate online and us setting up the Fronius Inverter account wasn't that straight forward. I think for people not familiar with this tech the Fronius website could be more user friendly and more representative of individual systems. I still don't understand the alert/reports I occasionally get. However the Tesla battery App is great, so simple as and tells us what we need to know so we don't bother with Fronius App or website anymore.Grid connection was all part of the install as far as I know but our retailer was slow getting in touch so we were exporting power for a couple of months without an arrangement. I contacted our installer who moved things along and now we are all good. Very happy customers. Thank you.
Installation was on Time as discussed.Sales and quoting process was good.This was for an off-grid system and they seemed to do a quality job.
